author: Claude 2026-11-21; GPT reviews, Cursor runs (user split 2026-11-16)
question: value of upstream observations on top of GFS as the GFS feed gets older (NWP latency), LightGBM only
cycle_rule: cycle(t0, d) = floor((t0 - d) / 6 h) * 6 h; age = t0 - cycle in [d, d + 5]; leads outside [3, 18] h masked (no f000, no lead > 18)
nominal_binding: for d = 6 the rebuilt last-step GFS columns 20..48 must equal the frozen x50 of EVERY train/V1/V2/test window (atol 1e-5) before any fit
cohorts: exactly the X2 part-A windows (run_x2.load_farm with configs/x2_protocol.json splits); formal runs check issue/turbine/truth hashes against output/x2/x2_0f24875/a/A/<farm>_cohorts.json

arms.matched: per delay d: LG_d and LUG_d fitted on GFS columns rebuilt at delay d (train, V1, V2, tests all at d); LU fitted once (delay-independent, = GFS outage endpoint)
arms.mismatch: LG_d6 / LUG_d6 boosters applied to inputs rebuilt at every other d (unexpected latency, prediction only)
arms.mix: LG_mix / LUG_mix fitted once with every train and V1 window at a delay drawn uniformly from delays_hours (numpy default_rng(2024), train and V1 drawn separately), evaluated at every d

lightgbm: configs/x1_protocol.json lightgbm grid (2x2), objective l1, early stopping on V1; seed 2024 only (all arms); run_x2.run_a_farm reused unchanged

readouts.U_rise: U_matched(18) - U_matched(6), paired on the same windows
readouts.descriptive_support: H_latency (upstream value rises with GFS latency) is called supported on V2 if U_rise > 0 with CI lower bound > 0 in at least 2 of 3 farms; otherwise reported as not supported. Descriptive, no method claim.
readouts.also: Spearman of U_matched over delays per farm; mismatch and mix MAE per delay; MAE(LUG_mix@d) - MAE(LUG_d)
